description: WHEN CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at :357 with both typed criteria valid - the one case of the twenty in which neither filter flag ends NOT-OK nor BLANK. :610-612 sets INPUT-OK and both ISVALID, and the two edits move through deliberately asymmetric views: CC-ACCT-ID at :675-678 is the alphanumeric one, CC-CARD-NUM-N at :716-719 the numeric REDEFINES. INPUT-ERROR is therefore false at :360, the ELSE at :364-369 reads then sends, and :588 names CCARD-NEXT-PROG - which is why nextProgram is set here and blank on the card-list arm. The read at :742-750 returns NORMAL, so :753-754 sets FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT, an 88-level on WS-INFO-MSG PIC X(40): the one SET that records the hit also puts '   Displaying requested details' in the info line, which makes WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE false at :490, suppresses the prompt and sends INFOMSGC to DFHNEUTR at :556 instead of DFHBMDAR. :474-485 then paints all four detail fields, EXPMONO and EXPYEARO through the CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE-X overlay rather than by parsing the date. Because this turn did not arrive from the card list - CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET is 'COCRDSL', not LIT-CCLISTMAPSET 'COCRDLI' - :509-511 moves DFHBMFSE, unprotected and FSET, into ACCTSIDA and CARDSIDA of CCRDSLAI where case02 gets the DFHBMPRF of :507-508, which is the difference between a criterion the operator may retype and one the list already chose; a send cannot observe those two bytes, since ACCTSIDA REDEFINES ACCTSIDF where CCRDSLAO declares FILLER, so the attributes asserted are the output quad and every colour among them is the LOW-VALUES :428 wrote - :533-539 finds neither flag NOT-OK and :541-551 neither BLANK, so no DFHRED and no '*' anywhere, the counterpart of the highlight case03 and case06 pin. The cursor EVALUATE at :515-524 falls past all four preceding WHENs to WHEN OTHER at :522-523, landing on the same ACCTSIDL the first arm would have chosen: same field, distinct arm, and the only case that reaches it. Rule R1 - the mandated name says Select where the source Function header, README.md:213-231 and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:220 DESCRIPTION(VIEW CARD DETAIL) say view; the name is honoured, the divergence documented rather than corrected. Statically derived and never executed: taken from app/cbl/COCRDSLC.cbl, the app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy layout, the xxxI clauses of app/cpy-bms/COCRDSL.CPY and row 0 of the real fixture. Pins G30, G37, G45, G47 on its NORMAL arm and G51; G32, G35 and G39 have no site here.
